summary: Iteration 118 — Full test of the new Zyxel Nebula (NCC OpenAPI) integration. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed against the real Nebula cloud with the already-stored encrypted key (config masked preview, /admin/zyxel/test ok=true org_count=41 pro=33, organizations cached + refresh, org sites/devices, links with device_count, fleet devices with live metrics, sync-now, PUT/GET/DELETE client link with immediate sync, 404/422 negative cases, unauthenticated 401). Frontend: /settings/zyxel loads, CONFIGURATA badge + masked key (AUND****0AST), mapping card with 41-option org dropdown pre-selected to '86 Bit · PRO' (1 device), Flotta card shows USG FLEX 700H ONLINE CPU 4-5% / MEM 38% / sessions 1472-1504 / firmware 1.39(ABZI.0). 'Sincronizza ora' -> loading toast then success toast '1 device sincronizzati su 1 clienti' (~10s). 'Test connessione' -> toast 'Connessione OK · 41 organizzazioni (33 PRO)' (~3s). 'Aggiorna org (41)' -> '41 organizzazioni aggiornate'. All zyxel API calls returned 200, no console errors. Existing config and 86BIT_Office mapping left untouched; temp test client+link created and removed (verified).

issues: Cosmetic: with a single client/device the page ends around 470px leaving a large empty area below; consider a compact layout or an empty-state hint for unmapped clients.
Cosmetic: the masked preview 'AUND****0AST' exposes the first 4 and last 4 chars of the OpenAPI key in a public badge; consider showing only the last 4.

action_items: No blocking fixes required for this feature.

Consider (non-blocking): multi-tenant scoping on GET /api/zyxel/devices and GET /api/clients/{id}/zyxel/devices — currently any authenticated user (any role) can read the whole Zyxel fleet of every tenant; only mutating endpoints call require_admin.

Consider (non-blocking): POST /api/zyxel/sync-now syncs all mapped clients serially inside the HTTP request (many Nebula calls per device). With more mapped clients this can exceed the request/ingress timeout — move to a background task returning 202 or paginate.
Consider (non-blocking): db.zyxel_metrics receives an insert per firewall every 5 minutes with no TTL index — add a TTL/retention index.
critical_code_review_comments: zyxel_nebula.py read endpoints (/zyxel/devices, /zyxel/links, /zyxel/organizations, /clients/{id}/zyxel/devices) use get_current_user without tenant/role filtering — cross-tenant read exposure if non-admin roles exist.

sync_client_devices() performs N+ sequential cloud calls (online-status, system-status, traffic-usage per device) with 40s timeouts and 5-retry backoff; a single slow site can block sync-now for minutes.
GET /admin/zyxel/config is readable by any authenticated user (only PUT/DELETE are admin-gated); base_url + last_error are exposed.
Positive: API key is AES-encrypted, never logged or returned in clear; _id excluded from all responses; retry/backoff on 429/5xx implemented correctly.
